deviations.what: The patent rows are never filtered to cpc_seq == 0 and the first_listed_only argument is never used, so by default every code on a patent counts as a class (and a patent whose first-listed subclass is missing still contributes classes from its other codes), instead of only the first-listed code's subclass.

notes: Filing-year dating, missing-class removal, the t-5..t-1 base and t+1..t+3 forward windows (year t excluded), the anti-join count, the NA-on-empty-base and 0-on-empty-forward rules, firm-level joins, duplicate handling, and the deduplicated output rows and columns all match the spec. The only problem is that the first-listed-code rule (and the first_listed_only setting) is missing.
